description: Variation of condition U0183823 (approved drawings) and U0183811 (energy reduction) of planning permission 24/0568/VRC - Extension at rear to increase internal floorspace of the two second floor dwellings form 39sq.m to 52.sq.m, and form 44sq.m to 53sq.m; change of brick colour; rear facing first floor terraces; introduction of ground floor rear gate; repositioning of main front door entrance; removing courtyard windows; introduction of rooflights on main roof; raised parapet on rear ground floor roof extension. Reduce target reduction n Carbon Dioxide emissions beyond Building Control regulations requrement (2021) from 35% to 10%.
